extName.description: Extension name in the browser toolbar and chrome://extensions.

extDesc.message: Automatically detect AI-generated text on article pages.

setupRequired.message: Configure your model provider in Settings first.

sendingDetect.message: Sending detect request to active tab…

couldNotConnect.message: Could not connect to page. Try refreshing the page first.

detectionTriggered.message: Detection triggered! Check the page for results.

optionsSubtitle.message: Configure the AI Text Detector extension.

urlMustHttp.message: URL must use http or https

localContentHint.message: Also label the page with your content categories.

contentCategoriesHint.message: These categories and descriptions are sent to your selected model as the classification prompt. Add or remove categories to match what you want to detect.

categoryRequired.message: Every category needs a name, and at least one category is required.

domainHint.message: Whitelisted domains are always detected, blacklisted domains are always skipped. The whitelist takes priority.

domainAlreadyListed.message: That domain is already in this list.

domainNote.message: You can also add the site you are browsing from the popup.

detectionDisabled.message: Detection is disabled. Enable it in the popup.

noServiceWorkerResponse.message: No response from the extension background

notAnArticle.message: Page does not appear to be an article

missingAiJudgment.message: The model did not return an AI judgment

showBadgePercentHint.message: Display the confidence score next to the label.

minTextLengthHint.message: Shorter pages are skipped during auto-detection.

providerBaseHint.message: API root, such as https://api.typesafe.ai or http://localhost:8000.

providerApiKeyHint.message: Stored only in this browser’s local extension storage. Optional for Laya unless your server requires authentication.

connectionTestHint.message: Clef and Laya connection tests run a small inference request. Clef may charge for it; Laya’s first request may load the model.

jevProviderHint.message: TypeSafe decision model. Enter your server URL and API key. You can also enter a pinned model version.

clefProviderHint.message: Cloudflare Workers AI. Enter your account ID and a Workers AI API token. Choose clef-flash or clef.

layaProviderHint.message: Connect to your own laya-serve instance. The multilingual model is recommended for Chinese and mixed-language pages.

invalidAccountId.message: Enter a valid 32-character Cloudflare account ID

providerAuthFailed.message: The model provider rejected the API key / token
